name: Kerry Titheradge
headline: Captain on Bravo’s Below Deck
on_the_show: Captain Kerry first met Dave more than 20 years ago as a patient with a rotator cuff injury, and credits Dave and his team with getting his shoulder back after two later surgeries. He talked about his own podcast, where he interviews well known people to show the struggles behind their success, and his Mental Health Mondays. He also described how a birthday toy drive at a watch party during his first season showed him what the platform could do, and the dog rescue and veterans charities he now supports.
on_the_show_quote: It’s very little effort for me to get in a car and drive an hour… just to help others out.

background.text: He was born in Brisbane, Australia, and has worked on boats for about 30 years, about two decades of that on yachts.
He captained the inaugural charter of Below Deck Adventure, which premiered on Bravo in November 2022.
He took the helm of Below Deck for Season 11 aboard the motor yacht St. David, chartering in Grenada.
He is back as captain for Below Deck Season 13, which premiered in October 2026.
He is the owner and CEO of Yachting Concepts, a yacht management company that helps new yacht owners find their way in the industry.
Off the boat, he rescues huskies.

research_notes: Instagram handle capt_kerry is now independently verified: Bravo's network article links it as his account. The profile page itself could not be opened from here (Instagram returns a login wall / 429), so the account's current bio was not seen. Bravo gives two experience figures: 'more than 20 years of experience in the yachting industry' and 'more than 30 years of experience in the industry' (the 11 Things article); I used the Who Is article's own breakdown (about 30 years on boats, about two decades on yachts). His podcast is named on air only in garbled ASR ('charted in the course and weathering the storms within'); no web source found, so no podcast link and no title. Bravo also links a Yachting Concepts Instagram (instagram.com/yachtingconceptskeza) from the 2023 article; left out because it could not be checked as active. Location left blank: Bravo says he lives in Palm Beach Gardens, but that is his residence, not a practice. Bravo's personal-life details (divorce, partner, children) deliberately excluded. Affiliation left null so the role line does not repeat Below Deck; Bravo profile stays in links.
